title: ai18n policy
description: ai18n.yaml: the language each surface uses, for any AI (SPEC.md). Data only: fixed keys, language tags and globs. A file without the ai18n key is version 0 (a classic languages.yaml) and may only declare respond, speak, document and code.

speak.description: Talk the human reads or hears: personas, agent-to-agent messages, voice.

code.description: Inside code: comments, docstrings, log/CLI/error messages, identifiers.

instruct.description: Text written for AIs: skills, agent prompts.

ui.description: User-facing UI text; delegate means each app's own i18n decides.

default.description: Language of any surface this file does not declare.

paths.description: Path rules, tried in order; the first match wins over the content rule.

language.description: A language tag in canonical case, a subset of BCP 47: an ISO 639 language code, then an optional ISO 15924 script and an optional ISO 3166-1 or UN M.49 region. Examples: en, es, pt-BR, zh-Hant, es-419, sr-Latn-RS.
